STEP 1 - Scene: A breakfast tray with fried eggs, grilled mushrooms, toast, a jam/butter portion, and a milky coffee or latte. Photographed from above at a moderate angle, straight-on from the front.

STEP 2 - Ruler: The main plate (with eggs and mushrooms) is an oval/round plate about 22 cm across, a bit smaller than a dinner plate. Area ≈ 3.14 × (11)² ≈ 380 cm². The toast plate is a side plate about 16 cm across (area ≈ 200 cm²). The mug is about 9 cm tall.

STEP 3 - Items: two fried eggs, sautéed mushrooms, one slice of toasted white bread, a small butter or jam portion (tiny, ~10 g), and coffee/latte with milk (~200 ml).

STEP 4 - Area (of the main plate, ~380 cm²):
- Fried eggs (two): ~30% ≈ 115 cm²
- Mushrooms: ~10% ≈ 38 cm²
- Toast (on separate plate, ~200 cm² plate, toast covers ~60% ≈ 120 cm²)

STEP 5 - Volume:
- Eggs: 115 cm² × 1.0 cm ≈ 115 ml
- Mushrooms: 38 cm² × 1.5 cm ≈ 57 ml
- Toast slice: roughly 10 × 10 × 2 cm ≈ 200 ml envelope, but a bread slice is ~ 10 × 10 × 1.8 cm, so use 18 ml per... recomputed as slice volume ≈ 110 ml
- Latte: ~200 ml

STEP 6 - Grams:
- Eggs: 115 ml × 0.95 ≈ 110 g (two fried eggs with some oil, ~110 g)
- Mushrooms (cooked, with oil): 57 ml × 0.6 ≈ 35 g
- Toast slice: ~30 g (a slice of white toast weighs about 30 g)
- Butter/jam portion: ~10 g
- Latte: ~200 g

STEP 7 - Energy:
- Fried eggs: 110 g × 196 kcal/100 g ≈ 216 kcal
- Mushrooms, cooked: 35 g × 30 kcal/100 g ≈ 11 kcal (fried in oil, plus oil, call it ~25 kcal)
- Toast (white bread, toasted): 30 g × 270 kcal/100 g ≈ 81 kcal
- Butter portion: 10 g × 717 kcal/100 g ≈ 72 kcal
- Latte (whole milk): 200 g × 50 kcal/100 g ≈ 100 kcal (milk-based, ~50 kcal/100 g)

STEP 8 - Sanity check: Total solid food ≈ 110 + 35 + 30 + 10 ≈ 185 g, roughly 390 kcal in food. With the latte, the meal is about 385 g and about 490 kcal. This is a plausible light breakfast for this visible portion.
